TeamworkAndCollaboration.description: Participation in and contribution to group projects, teams, or collaborative initiatives. Focus on ability to work effectively with others towards a shared goal.

EvidenceEntries.description: List of evidence entries found in participant documentation related to teamwork and collaboration.

TeamworkAndCollaboration.EvidenceEntries:
Title of Project or Experience
List a specific team project, group work, etc. found in the documentation. Describe the candidate's role and how they contributed in this example. Detail instances where their work led to team success or how they helped resolve issues. Describe the size of the team, duration of the project, and complexity of the task.
List bullet points providing concrete evidence (e.g., "Led subgroup responsible for X", "Collaborated on Y report"). Add observations about the *quality* of collaboration demonstrated based on the evidence (e.g., "Strong example of mediating conflict", "Role description for team project is minimal").
